versions.content: Checks for DDDIDs in ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A), if verifica- tion has been successfully done ([SWS_Dcm_00721], [SWS_Dcm_00722] and [SWS_Dcm_00820]), and if the request contains one or more dynamically defined DID(s), the Dcm module shall do the session, security and mode dependencies checks for all source data in case the configuration parameter DcmDspDDDIDcheckPer- SourceDID is set to TRUE.
